
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /switch  (/model)                          │
  │  Quick Switch Provider/Model                │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Interactively switch your AI provider and model.

  Usage:
    /switch

  Details:
    Opens an interactive menu to select a new provider (Claude, GPT-5,
    OpenRouter) and then pick a model. Requires an API key already
    configured in your .env file. The ChatGPT subscription entry opens
    its own menu for sign in, sign out, plan and quota, models, and
    switching this session onto your ChatGPT plan.

  Examples:
    $ /switch
    $ /model

  Tips:
    Tip: Use /free to instantly switch to the cheapest model.

  Related: /config  /free
